race.comment: MO SPIRIT (8) has been knocking on the door for a maiden victory and looks well placed to finally break through. He resumed with a solid placing at Bowen before finding stronger company a little too testing at Townsville, and this assignment appears far more suitable, so he goes on top for us. CINCHICATED (9) has shown ability in his brief career, including an encouraging placing fresh up at Rockhampton, and she is capable of bouncing back after a luckless effort here last start. ATOMIC TIME (1) has been remarkably consistent this prep with 3 placings from as many outings and again looks likely to be in the thick of the action. STYLISH ROSIE (6) should settle prominently after a solid Townsville placing, while ANTHROPOLOGY (3) resumes off a recent trial win and is worth keeping safe fresh. Use the market as a guide.
